drhp.business: Panorama Studios International Limited (PSIL) develops, produces and participates in film projects across languages and genres, and distributes and exhibits them theatrically. Its subsidiaries include Panorama Studios Private Limited, Panorama Music Private Limited, Panorama Music Regional Private Limited, Brain on Rent LLP and Panorama Studios Inflight LLP. The Chairman's message states its focus on building a balanced portfolio of commercially viable content while expanding its intellectual property portfolio and distribution reach.

demand_drivers.body:
- Theatrical revenues recovered during 2025, which management reads as audiences continuing to value event-oriented cinematic content.
- Digital platforms, Connected TVs, smartphones and regional-language content are creating a more fragmented but larger addressable audience.
- Digital advertising grew by approximately 26% in 2025 and accounted for nearly two-thirds of India's total advertising revenues (industry-level, per Chairman's message).

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Build a balanced portfolio of commercially viable and creatively compelling content while keeping financial discipline and prudent risk management.
- Evaluate opportunities that enhance the intellectual property portfolio and expand distribution reach.
- Strengthen presence in theatrical distribution and exhibition to maximise the commercial potential of content.
- Develop and participate in diverse film projects across languages and genres (content-driven strategy).
